key_difference: (D) leaves the compile-time QtPrivate::ConnectionTypes logic untouched and instead registers moc's recorded parameter types at runtime in connectImpl, and only for explicit Queued/BlockingQueued connections; (B) makes ConnectionTypes build the type-id array for every complete, non-reference argument type, using a UniqueType-guarded completeness check, so registration also happens for AutoConnection (the default, which becomes queued across threads) and for every connect call.
